quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on overcoming size barriers in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I just wanted to play basketball and just so happened that folks had their own belief
quotes.quote: I just wanted to play basketball and just so happened that folks had their own belief of what a person should look like and how they should be to pursue that game. Basketball with which folks think that it should be only played by bigger and taller players and the position that I chose to play or it chose me in terms of position wise. I was 14 years old when I first heard about a Magic Johnson. Being compared to someone that that size, saying that you shouldn't and you can't, don't even waste your time, just motivated me just to go out there and just want to be accepted. The way I approach the game was play against the best, you have success against the best, you need to be included with the best.
quotes.social_post: Muggsy Bogues reflects on his journey to the NBA and the doubters he faced. He says he was motivated by those who told him he could not play because of his size, stating he just wanted to go out there and be accepted.

structured.context: Muggsy Bogues reflects on his career and overcoming skepticism about his height during his jersey retirement ceremony.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on his special bond with Dell Curry
quotes.excerpt: That's a special bond right there with he and I because we came here in 1988
quotes.quote: That's a special bond right there with he and I because we came here in 1988. I was 19 years old, he was 20 years old. We were still pursuing our dream. We both got drafted highly from an organization that decided to let us go. We came here and understood what the task was and what we were trying to accomplish. For some reason, he and I really clicked. We knew each other from college days, but we didn't know each other that well, but we just gravitated toward each other. We both had similar situations. I had a kid, he had a kid, and we were understanding that the NBA was something that we wanted to continue and not just have a short stay.
quotes.social_post: Muggsy Bogues on his bond with Dell Curry. The two arrived in Charlotte in 1988 and gravitated toward each other because they both had similar situations and a shared desire to stay in the league.

structured.context: Muggsy Bogues discusses his close friendship and shared experiences with former teammate Dell Curry since joining the Hornets in 1988.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on Rick Schnall and Gabe Plotkin's leadership
quotes.excerpt: They have a different understanding how they want to run their organization
quotes.quote: They have a different understanding how they want to run their organization and how they feel that folks need to be part and be recognized in certain way. And starting with Dell, of course, we had Bobby Phills up there, rightfully so. Starting with Dell, which was the right decision by hanging him up first. Him being the first selected, being able to do the things not just on the court but off the court as well with he and I both meant for this community. We embraced it. We truly did.
quotes.social_post: Muggsy Bogues praises the Hornets organization for how they recognize their legends, noting that Dell Curry was the right choice to be the first player honored by the team.

structured.context: Muggsy Bogues praises the leadership of Rick Schnall and Gabe Plotkin and discusses the recognition of Dell Curry and Bobby Phills.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on Coach Wes Unseld's fatherly influence
quotes.excerpt: Coach Wes Unseld, who's been our, been like a father to us
quotes.quote: Coach Wes Unseld, who's been our, been like a father to us. Really just laid it all on the, laid it all out in terms of where it all started, where I've come from. So, I thought I wasn't going to do this, but yeah, you know, the Wes Unseld, the Reggie Williams, even the Dwayne Wood, a young man that I truly patted my game behind, someone that I looked up to for so long, never made it to the NBA. A friend that he made it was college, but the success that he had early on, growing up in the city of Baltimore, playing for Dunbar, really gave me an understanding or an idea that this thing is possible.
quotes.social_post: Muggsy Bogues credits the late Wes Unseld for being a father figure during his career and helping him realize that making it to the NBA was possible.

structured.context: Muggsy Bogues reflects on the influence of Wes Unseld and other figures from his youth in Baltimore on his basketball career.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on the Hornets' early years and team injuries
quotes.excerpt: Even though we didn't win a championship, we had some opportunities
quotes.quote: We are very proud and even though we didn't win a championship, we had some opportunities. The teams that we had, possibly making it to the Eastern Conference Finals, but it seemed like we always were derailed with some sort of injury. It's something that always came up with one of our core players and we weren't able to keep that core team together for a very long time, and they gave up on us I believe a little too, too early. But the teams that we were able to, the teams that I was able to play with, from the very first day that we played in the Charlotte Coliseum, playing against the Cleveland Cavaliers where we lost by 40 points, the very first day, we knew how special it was when the entire stands stood up and gave us a standing ovation.
quotes.social_post: Muggsy Bogues looks back at the early Hornets teams and believes they were derailed by injuries. He says they had the potential to reach the Eastern Conference Finals but were never able to keep their core together long enough.

structured.context: Muggsy Bogues discusses the challenges the early Hornets teams faced with injuries and their first game against the Cleveland Cavaliers.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on his legacy as a determined dreamer
quotes.excerpt: Just a kid that had a dream, didn't let anyone knock him off his dream
quotes.quote: Just a kid that had a dream, didn't let anyone knock him off his dream regardless of what the circumstances were, and he was able to go out and fulfill it to the highest level that he was able to, the highest pinnacle of his career which was the NBA. So, basically just somebody that just believed and never gave the outside noise any type of power over his belief that he had and the path that he was on.
quotes.social_post: Muggsy Bogues on his legacy. He wants to be remembered as a kid who had a dream and never gave the outside noise any power over his belief in the path he was on.

structured.context: Muggsy Bogues summarizes his legacy and his journey to the NBA during his jersey retirement ceremony.
